data.revised_prompt: Simple centered icon asset, bold silhouette, minimal detail, high contrast, readable at small sizes. Create a high-quality 3D chibi educational app style avatar of a fictional Chinese schoolgirl, age 8–14, for a campus teacher/student avatar library. One single character only. Square 1:1 composition, tightly focused on the head, front-facing or slight three-quarter view, with the full hair outline visible. Face and hair together occupy 75%–85% of the frame. Only a very small amount of shoulder/neck is visible at the bottom; absolutely not a half-body portrait. Clear student appearance, not adult. Soft studio lighting, delicate modeling, bright brown eyes. Expression: a slightly mischievous bright smile. Hairstyle: low twin ponytails, thin airy straight bangs, small red hair ties on both sides. Bottom edge shows only a tiny bit of a white school-collar, no logo, no text. Background must completely fill the entire square edge-to-edge and corner-to-corner with a low-saturation light mint green, with no white border, no transparency, no circular frame, no ring, no halo, no scene. Hair, expression, and accessories must remain easily distinguishable at 48px. Clean, polished, cute, high-detail 3D render, clearly an elementary-to-middle-school student avatar.
